PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Certified SAFe POPM and PSPO I certified professional with 11 years of experience in Product Management, Product Ownership and Business Analysis across healthcare and manufacturing domains. Proven expertise in defining product vision, managing roadmaps and backlogs, driving end-to-end product delivery and translating complex business needs into customer-centric solutions for web, mobile and SaaS products. Skilled in Agile delivery, stakeholder management, data-driven decision-making, AI-assisted product development, process optimization, and cross- functional leadership to deliver scalable, high-quality products.

CORE SKILLS





Product Ownership: Product vision & strategy, roadmap planning, requirements gathering, elicitation & documentation (Functional & Non-Functional Requirements), FRDs, BRDs, backlog prioritization, epics & user stories, AI use cases, MVP scoping, go-to-market readiness, ROI, KPI definition, change management, product demonstrations, user acceptance testing, human-in-the loop controls, continuous product improvement Cross-Functional Collaboration: UX/UI and Engineering teams, stakeholder management, Agile/Scrum/Kanban methodologies, dependency and risk management, scope trade-offs, business process improvement, workflow automation; partnering with engineering and Data Science teams on AI-enabled features

Domain Knowledge: US Healthcare clinical workflows, Ambulatory & Inpatient workflows, Clinical Documentation, HIPAA/FHIR/HL7, ICD/CPT/HCPCS coding standards, governance & compliance, SaaS web & mobile (iOS/Android) product delivery; manufacturing operations

Data Analytics: AS-IS and TO-BE process assessment, A/B testing, SQL, MS Excel, MS Power BI, Tableau ●

Tools: Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence, Figma (AI-assisted prototyping), Balsamiq (wireframing), Postman (API Testing), LLM-based tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Co-Pilot, Atlassian ROVO)

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Lead Analyst R Systems International Ltd. | Pune | 09/2025 – Present

Own and maintain the product backlog and roadmap for cloud-based SaaS healthcare web and mobile applications, prioritizing enhancements based on customer needs, business value, delivery timelines and development capacity, achieving 95% on-time product delivery.

Analyze business requirements, workflows and customer journeys across web portals, mobile applications and backend services;





identify gaps, impacts and opportunities for product and process improvements. Lead requirement discovery with business stakeholders and translate business needs into functional requirements, epics, user stories and acceptance criteria, ensuring development-ready specifications. Run market research and competitor analysis to identify growth opportunities in clinical workflows, translating findings into features that lift product adoption by 20–25%.

Hands-on experience with Azure OpenAI and Azure AI Services, contributing to AI-enabled healthcare product features and solutions across requirements, product prioritization, validation and delivery.

Worked with Large Language Models (LLMs) and AI-assisted capabilities to define and deliver healthcare use cases, collaborating with Product, Engineering and Data Science teams to translate business requirements into AI product features.

Use generative AI tools for requirements discovery, analysis, documentation, UI prototyping, and backlog artifact creation, reducing



documentation effort by 30–40% and shortening design-to-development cycles by 25% through faster concept validation. Partner closely with Product, UX/UI, Architects, Engineering and QA teams to clarify requirements, resolve dependencies and align sprint execution with roadmap priorities.

Analyze product and delivery metrics including velocity, backlog health, release readiness and post-release defects to support data- driven decisions, contributing to a 20% reduction in post-release defects.

Analyze existing business processes and implement workflow automation and process improvements, reducing process inefficiencies by 25%.

Validate API integrations between mobile applications, backend services and web applications and support end-to-end validation and



perform UAT in a regulated healthcare environment. Lead backlog refinement, sprint planning, daily stand-ups, product demos and retrospectives, tightening feedback loops while maintaining delivery readiness and stakeholder alignment across distributed US and India teams.

Maintain the Requirement Traceability Matrix (RTM) and coordinate Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA) to ensure end-to-end requirements traceability, test coverage, and effective defect resolution. Coordinate end-to-end release activities, proactively managing risks and dependencies through effective stakeholder communication



and release governance.

● Mentor junior Product Owners and run knowledge-sharing sessions across teams

Product Owner / Business Analyst

Altera Digital Health | Pune | 03/2022 – 09/2025

Drove end-to-end product delivery for thin and thick EHR (Electronic Health Record) application, partnering with clinical and business stakeholders to analyze requirements, workflows and business needs and translate them into product requirements, epics, user stories and acceptance criteria.

Owned and prioritized the product backlog across multiple releases for Ambulatory and Inpatient workflows, spanning Clinical Documentation, Results, Orders, Allergies & Health Issues, regulatory-driven enhancements, and AI-assisted clinical workflows. ● Delivered AI Assist and Copilot-based capabilities within healthcare product workflows, leveraging AI to improve clinical workflows, documentation, user experience and operational efficiency.

Defined and managed AI/GenAI product requirements, use cases, epics, user stories and acceptance criteria, incorporating human-in-





the-loop controls, AI validation and healthcare compliance considerations across the product lifecycle. Evaluated business and clinical requirements, system functionality and regulatory impacts to identify gaps, dependencies and implementation considerations. Ensured system configuration and delivered functionality aligned with clinical workflows, organizational standards and healthcare regulatory requirements.

Worked closely with Product Management, Engineering, UX/UI and QA to clarify requirements, resolve business rules and support





implementation throughout the development lifecycle. Led cross-functional Agile teams through sprint planning, backlog refinement, sprint demos and retrospectives while removing delivery blockers and maintaining development readiness. Collaborated closely with UX/UI teams to deliver intuitive, user-centric designs, measurably improving usability and customer experience.

Defined and reported KPIs; managed change and delivery governance across the SDLC. ●

Planned and coordinated releases across Product, Engineering, QA and business stakeholders; performed UAT, API integration testing and end-to-end validation, proactively managing risk and reducing defects.

Used Azure DevOps metrics including velocity, sprint health and backlog metrics to support delivery planning and continuous product

improvement. Identified product enhancement and process optimization opportunities through stakeholder feedback, market research, and analysis of product usage and customer needs. Created release notes, documented defects, and developed and maintained handover training materials and project documentation.



● Delivered product demos and conducted handover/training sessions for client support, implementation, technical authors, and education teams, enabling rapid feedback loops, cross-functional alignment, effective end-user training, and adoption of new features.

Business Analyst II GGS Information Services India Pvt. Ltd. (on-site at John Deere India) | Pune | 11/2017 – 02/2022



Supported Product Owner with backlog management, requirements analysis and delivery planning, aligning solutions with product and business objectives.

Analyzed business processes, performed gap analysis and identified opportunities for operational improvement. ● Translated business requirements into functional specifications and user stories and performed UAT to validate delivered functionality.

Developed Tableau dashboards providing stakeholders with self-service performance insights to support data-driven decision- making.

Technical Sales Coordinator Treo Engineering Pvt. Ltd. | Pune | 11/2016 – 11/2017

Acted as key liaison between sales, engineering and operations; prepared technical proposals, bids and quotes aligned to customer needs and pricing. Provided pre- and post-sales support, improving customer satisfaction by 25%.



Sales Coordinator Summit Corporation Pvt. Ltd. | Pune | 08/2015 – 11/2016

●

Liaised between customers and technical teams; managed client communication, proposals and delivery planning. Conducted feasibility analysis, estimation and scope alignment against customer needs.

CERTIFICATIONS

Certified SAFe 5 Product Owner / Product Manager ● Professional Scrum Product Owner I (PSPO I) ● Certified SAFe 5 Agilist ● Agile Certified Practitioner(Simplilearn)

Bachelor of Engineering (B.E.), Mechanical Engineering

University of Pune (Savitribai Phule Pune University), Pune, India · 2014

English | Hindi | Marathi
